scope.question: Audit whether current flavin_monooxygenase/FMO evidence is overfit to PHBH-like geometry or whether BVMO/HAPMO/FMO1 represent genuinely separate FMO subtypes.
scope.network_and_disk_policy: No large downloads were performed. This audit uses existing local artifacts/caches and prior small metadata lookup artifacts as review context.

registry_level.interpretation: The registry wording is broad enough for BVMO, aromatic hydroxylase, and class B FMO chemistry, but it is a single parent lane with no subtype axes.

source_free_geometry_and_counterevidence.flavin_site_extractor: Source-free flavin extraction accepts FAD, FMN, or RBF and requires nearby generic flavin-binder, redox/acid-base, and electron-transfer residues using 4.2 A and 5.0 A contact cutoffs.
source_free_geometry_and_counterevidence.cofactor_scoring: FAD/FMN ligand family support is scored as generic flavin context; NAD(P) ligand family support is scored separately.
source_free_geometry_and_counterevidence.substrate_pocket_scoring: FMO pocket scoring favors a hydrophobic fraction near 0.4 plus aromatic and polar content; it does not directly score Baeyer-Villiger, N/S oxygenation, or two-component FMNH2 chemistry.
phbh_like_special_cases: PHB and BR are the only explicit flavin_monooxygenase substrate ligand codes in the counterevidence rules.
FAD/FMN without NAD-family ligand is penalized for flavin_monooxygenase unless PHB/BR substrate context is present.
flavin_dehydrogenase_reductase is penalized when PHB/BR substrate context appears without electron-transfer residue context.
source_free_geometry_and_counterevidence.observed_prior_screen_behavior: In the 2026-05-21 FMO deep packet, all seven source-free geometry rows scored top1 as flavin_dehydrogenase_reductase. The FMO lane was never top1; only H3JQW0 reached the FMO floor because it had FAD plus NADP.
source_free_geometry_and_counterevidence.interpretation: The active source-free scorer is not a clean C4a oxygen-transfer detector. It is biased toward generic flavin redox unless a PHBH-like substrate exception or NAD(P) ligand is present.

local_coordinate_assumptions_from_fmo_li.review_assumption: FAD/NADPH, reduced flavin plus O2, C4a-peroxy or C4a-hydroperoxy FAD, aromatic hydroxylation of 4-hydroxybenzoate.
local_coordinate_assumptions_from_fmo_li.geometry_role_in_current_system: This is the dominant clean aromatic-hydroxylase reference lane and anchors the PHB/BR special-case substrate context.

local_coordinate_assumptions_from_fmo_li.review_assumption: Reduced FMN is supplied to the oxygenase; FMN-peroxo/C4a-peroxy chemistry oxygenates aldehyde substrate.
local_coordinate_assumptions_from_fmo_li.geometry_role_in_current_system: Valid FMO-like oxygenation, but its reductant/partner logic differs from single-component FAD/NADPH enzymes.

local_coordinate_assumptions_from_fmo_li.flavin_state: FAD present; no C4a-hydroperoxy/peroxide state in selected coordinate.
local_coordinate_assumptions_from_fmo_li.substrate_or_analog: IPH present. Prior mapped chain A FAD C4X-to-IPH O1 distance is 7.10 A; local adjudication found productive author chain C at 4.582 A and chain D at 4.649 A.
local_coordinate_assumptions_from_fmo_li.reductant_or_partner_assumption: NADPH/NADP absent from 1FOH is a structural-state caveat, not a chemistry rejection.
local_coordinate_assumptions_from_fmo_li.interpretation: This row supports the aromatic hydroxylase stratum but also shows that chain/materialization choice can dominate the apparent geometry gate.

local_coordinate_assumptions_from_fmo_li.flavin_state: FMN present; no C4a-hydroperoxy/peroxide state in selected coordinate.
local_coordinate_assumptions_from_fmo_li.substrate_or_analog: No substrate or substrate analog present in selected 3X0Y coordinate.
active_site_residues_and_distances: FMN C4A to Tyr96 OH: 3.37 A
FMN C4A to Ser163 OG: 3.69 A
FMN C4A to His391 NE2: 4.23 A
local_coordinate_assumptions_from_fmo_li.reductant_or_partner_assumption: NADPH/NADP absence is not a blocker because reduced FMNH2 is supplied by a partner reductase.
local_coordinate_assumptions_from_fmo_li.interpretation: This row is valid subtype diversity and should not be failed by a single-component NADPH-ligand requirement.

external_exact_coordinate_materializatio.Q93TJ5_HAPMO: Exact coordinate in the current pass is AlphaFold protein-only with no FAD, NAD(P), substrate, analog, or product.
external_exact_coordinate_materializatio.Q01740_FMO1: Exact coordinate in the current pass is AlphaFold protein-only with no FAD, NAD(P), substrate, analog, or product.
external_exact_coordinate_materializatio.H3JQW0_OTEMO: Exact PDB 3UOY has FAD and NADP but no substrate/analog/product and remains a duplicate/family hold.
external_exact_coordinate_materializatio.O15229_KMO: Exact PDB 5X68 has FAD but no substrate/analog/product and remains a duplicate/leakage hold against m_csa:131.

subtype_comparison.chemistry: Single-component FAD/NAD(P)H aromatic hydroxylation or oxidative decarboxylating hydroxylation through reduced flavin plus O2 and C4a-hydroperoxyflavin chemistry.
subtype_comparison.relationship_to_current_gate: Best represented by current artifacts; PHB/BR special-case ligand logic makes this the most natural fit.
subtype_comparison.decision: In scope, but KMO and salicylate are mostly duplicate or family-overlap support under current acquisition policy.

subtype_comparison.chemistry: FAD/NADPH Baeyer-Villiger oxygen insertion into carbonyl substrates, forming lactone or ester products through peroxyflavin oxygen transfer.
subtype_comparison.relationship_to_current_gate: Registry scope includes BVMOs, but current source-free geometry lacks a BVMO-specific substrate/product geometry feature and tends to collapse FAD/NAD(P) context into generic flavin_dehydrogenase_reductase.
subtype_comparison.decision: Genuine FMO subtype diversity. CHMO and HAPMO are non-duplicate source-clean acquisition leads, but current exact-coordinate materialization is missing.

subtype_comparison.chemistry: Single-chain FAD/NADPH FMO forms a relatively stable C4a-hydroperoxyflavin oxygenating species for N- and S-oxygenation of soft nucleophiles.
subtype_comparison.relationship_to_current_gate: Not PHBH-like: substrate classes, active-site residues, and product chemistry differ from aromatic hydroxylases and BVMOs. A NADPH/FAD-only geometry gate will over-absorb it into generic flavin redox if substrate/peroxy evidence is absent.
subtype_comparison.decision: Genuine separate FMO subtype. The blocker is lack of exact ligand-bearing FMO1 coordinate materialization, not out-of-scope chemistry.

subtype_comparison.chemistry: Reduced FMNH2 is supplied by a partner or reductase context, then the oxygenase component uses C4a-peroxy or C4a-hydroperoxy FMN chemistry for aldehyde or sulfur oxygenation.
subtype_comparison.relationship_to_current_gate: A mandatory local NADP(H) ligand assumption is inappropriate. Partner-supplied reduced flavin must be represented as a separate reductant-context axis.
subtype_comparison.decision: Genuine separate subtype or child stratum. DszC is in scope but needs substrate/peroxy coordinate materialization for coordinate-clean status.

subtype_comparison.chemistry: Ordinary flavin hydride/electron transfer, oxidase O2 acceptor chemistry, halogenase chemistry, ATP/luciferyl oxygenation, flavodiiron NO reduction, radical flavin/Fe-S dehydration, or covalent FAD-adduct chemistry.
subtype_comparison.relationship_to_current_gate: These share flavin, oxygenase names, O2, or redox language but lack flavin-peroxy substrate oxygen insertion at the FMO locus.
subtype_comparison.decision: True out-of-scope or hard-negative controls, not evidence to narrow the FMO parent definition.

rationale: The semantic registry definition is broad enough for BVMO, aromatic hydroxylase, and class B FMO chemistry.
The implemented source-free gate is PHBH-leaning because PHB/BR are the only explicit FMO substrate exceptions and because FAD-only coordinates are penalized without local NAD(P) ligand.
The current external clean-row failure is dominated by exact coordinate absence for P12015, Q93TJ5, and Q01740, plus duplicate/family holds for H3JQW0, O15229, and P23262.
BVMO/HAPMO/FMO1 are valid FMO subtype diversity and should be separated in review panels before any canonical child promotion.

recommended_policy.top_line: Keep flavin_monooxygenase secondary-only; create review-only subtype panels and revise the silver/review evidence gate. Do not promote canonically.
review_silver_gate_revision: Require explicit review evidence for reduced FAD/FMN plus O2 forming C4a-hydroperoxyflavin, C4a-peroxyflavin, or equivalent flavin-peroxy oxygenating chemistry.

Require substrate oxygen insertion or oxygenation context: aromatic hydroxylation, oxidative decarboxylation, N-oxygenation, S-oxygenation, Baeyer-Villiger insertion, or aldehyde oxygenation as appropriate to subtype.

Treat local NADP(H) ligand absence as a coordinate-state caveat, not an automatic failure, when the source context supports partner-supplied FMNH2 or missing nicotinamide in an otherwise relevant structure.
Do not rely on PHB/BR ligand codes as the only FMO-positive substrate exceptions.

Tier exact ligand-bearing coordinates as gold/countable candidates only after duplicate/leakage and import gates; tier homologous ligand-bearing coordinates as silver/review-only diagnostics with source_accession_exact=false.

review_only_subtype_panels.use_now: review-only acquisition panel; CHMO/HAPMO are best non-duplicate exact-coordinate targets

exact_ligand_bearing_coordinate_targets.needed_coordinate: Exact experimental coordinate with FAD plus NADP(H) and cyclohexanone, caprolactone, or close substrate/product analog in the BVMO active site.
exact_ligand_bearing_coordinate_targets.why: Clean non-duplicate BVMO/lactone oxygen-insertion axis; current exact support is AlphaFold protein-only.

exact_ligand_bearing_coordinate_targets.needed_coordinate: Exact ligand-bearing FAD/NADP(H) coordinate with dimethylaniline, trimethylamine, hypotaurine/taurine, or product/analog geometry.
exact_ligand_bearing_coordinate_targets.why: Unique class B mammalian FMO N/S oxygenation subtype; current exact support is AlphaFold protein-only.

exact_ligand_bearing_coordinate_targets.needed_coordinate: Exact experimental FAD/NADP(H) coordinate with 4-hydroxyacetophenone, 4-acetoxyphenol, or close substrate/product analog.
exact_ligand_bearing_coordinate_targets.why: Source-clean HAPMO/aryl-ketone BVMO row; current exact support is AlphaFold protein-only.

exact_ligand_bearing_coordinate_targets.needed_coordinate: FMN-bound DszC coordinate with dibenzothiophene-family substrate, sulfoxide/sulfone product, or substrate analog near FMN C4A, ideally with partner/reduced-FMN state context.
exact_ligand_bearing_coordinate_targets.why: Mechanism-clean two-component FMNH2 sulfur monooxygenase, but current coordinate lacks substrate/analog and peroxy state.

exact_ligand_bearing_coordinate_targets.needed_coordinate: Use pdb:1FOH author chain C as the productive local copy for future pocket extraction; chain D is corroborating only.
exact_ligand_bearing_coordinate_targets.why: Repairs a materialization/chain-choice issue in the local aromatic hydroxylase support row without changing labels or imports.

known_useful_geometry: 3UCL has FAD + NADP + cyclohexanone with FAD C4X to CYH O1 at 3.008 A.
4RG3 has FAD + NADP + caprolactone with FAD C4X to ECE O at 3.529 A.
7AL4 provides high-identity FAD + NADP cofactor/fold review context.
6SE3 provides FAD + NADP + O2 oxygen-pocket context with O2 about 5.18-5.84 A from FAD C4X.
2YM1 provides broad BVMO FAD + NADP + O2 context with O2 near FAD C4X at 3.485 A.

bottom_line: The current FMO artifact stack is not simply rejecting BVMO/HAPMO/FMO1 because they are out of scope. The registry definition is broad, but the active source-free geometry/counterevidence gate is PHBH-leaning and generic-flavin-redox-prone, while the current external pass is chiefly blocked by missing exact ligand-bearing coordinates. Keep FMO secondary-only, split review/silver evidence into subtype panels, revise the silver gate, and do not promote canonically.
